## About
Premier Automotive Inc. is a small, down-to-earth repair shop on W Drake Dr in Tempe. We work on all makes and models, and the jobs run from a simple oil change all the way up to an engine replacement.
Bob and Dorie run the place, and customers tend to stick around. Reviewers talk about fair prices, straight answers and advice on what your car actually needs. One wrote that there was "no upsale just being real."
The quickest way to reach us is by phone. If calling doesn't fit your day, there's a contact form too.

## Services
- Brakes service and repair: Brakes service, repair and fluid replacement.
- Engine repair and replacement: From diagnosing engine problems to full replacements.
- Heating and air conditioning: Repair for your car's heating and A/C systems.
- Lube, oil and filter: Routine oil changes and filter maintenance.
- Muffler and exhaust: Maintenance and repair for mufflers and exhaust systems.
- Shocks, struts and CV joints: Maintenance and repair for shocks, struts and CV joints.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension services.
- Transmission inspection: Transmission inspection and fluid replacement.
- Electric windows and door locks: Maintenance for power windows and door locks.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Yes. We service all makes and models.

Q: My car won't drive. How do I get it to you?
A: Call Delta Towing at 602-451-4763 and ask for a direct tow to our shop.

Q: Do you honor AC Delco battery warranties?
A: Yes, we honor AC Delco battery warranties.

Q: What's the best way to reach you?
A: Calling is almost always the quicker way to get a response. If a call doesn't fit your schedule, you can use the contact form instead.
